decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The additional floorspace hereby permitted shall be used only for purposes ancillary to the permitted main use of the premises at Unit 1, 983 Great West Road, Great West Trading Estate, Brentford, TW8 9DN.

Condition : 5 - Within three months of this permission, the cycle parking spaces and the access to them shall be provided in accordance with the drawing No. 1630-PL-100_A and such spaces shall be permanently available for the users of the development.
description: Insertion of new windows in the front facade at mezzanine level, extension of the existing roof access at third floor to allow stair access to roof level from the existing internal staircase, addition of a metal balustrade to the existing roof parapet to allow the formation of a roof terrace and erection of an internal steel mezzanine floor within the unit over part of the factory floor.
